description: Search Skyline's certified records across Oklahoma property insurance, roofing regulation, insurance-industry news, and property/construction permits. Free — no API key required. All params optional and combinable. Pass `collection` to scope to one domain (e.g. `ok_property_permits`); omitting it scopes to `ok_roofing_insurance` only — call list_collections first to see the current roster.

city.description: Jurisdiction city — relevant to ok_property_permits (e.g. "Norman", "Oklahoma City")

collection.description: Which collection to search, e.g. "ok_roofing_insurance" (default) or "ok_property_permits". See list_collections for the current roster.

q.description: Free-text search over claim summary/detail, or over permit type/address/contractor

name: search_records
